column2: Write a 150-word abstract for our paper showing that deer herbivory pressure, measured as abundance times feeding time from camera traps, varies across the eastern US.
Draft a one-page specific aims for an NSF proposal on statistical methods for using AI species identifications in occupancy models.
Write a short blog post for a general audience about how fishers came back to Ohio.
Tighten this sentence from my manuscript: "We do not claim that a shift of that size carries a measurable cost to the animal, rather than merely a statistical one."
Write a three-sentence email to a co-author saying the revised methods section is attached and asking for comments by Friday.
I have a camera trap deployments table with deployment_id, start_time, end_time, latitude, longitude from three Snapshot USA projects. What should I check before fitting occupancy models?
